easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Changeling Titan must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Titan for its mana cost.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
